earthquakes.limitations: Reported magnitude and epicentral distance do not measure local danger.

aviation.limitations: Twenty archived observations from a single mission.

satellites.limitations: One-minute pass sampling above 10 degrees for 24 hours. Optical visibility depends on light, clouds and terrain.

weather.description: Hourly model temperature at two metres
weather.coverage: Open-Meteo forecast grid cell for the selected coordinates
weather.limitations: Up to 24 future hourly values. Grid cell can differ from the requested location.

wildfires.coverage: NASA EONET global open wildfire catalog
wildfires.limitations: Latest dated point in up to 40 open entries. Current fire activity is unconfirmed.

transport.limitations: A 100 km regional selection around NYC. Capacity is dock inventory.

infrastructure.limitations: Single station with a watch circle. Its listed position is approximate.

maritime.limitations: Two documented endpoints. Route between them is unknown.

warnings.description: Weather alert reported for a query point
warnings.coverage: Points covered by the US National Weather Service
warnings.limitations: A marker identifies the query point within the alert area.
